content: Lui a vainah

Ka uny sahlo, naa hrong letah mehlupui tah cawngpahtu cang a pachia khe lo, zecawtamaw tatah kaaning male a cawngpahpaw sahlo heh biacenah a pa-ih vypaw tah biacepah ka cang he peh takhah naa hni thlang kho.
Kaa zongmingtei hei a phingphing tah chahlynah kaa tua cy. A biarei letah panah a tua lypaw cawngsaw cawh mehtling cang ka, a pungpaluh a mingkai khypaw zong a cang.
Rang cawh kaa rei ma nge ná seh tatah a chaba kaa ba tihtah kaa dunah lang kaa mia khy.

A cang ly leh tuilawng sahlo kheh tawchingnah tah kaa hmang tua he a. Tuilawng cawh lai ngetei he ka, thli a rupaw pui tah a seisah he, a cang naná teitah a zeinah sung a chiapaw teitah khei uh he ka, a thetupaw takhei a dunah lang a seisah khy he.
Ma hraco lui heh pung letah a chia pawtei caibai a cang, canghrasala a pachaw a palaw ngetei. Mehli a chia pawtei tah lyraang a kang thlangpaw kheh pacang tua hmai o.

Lui zong heh me cang ka, pung letei chahlynah vytei a pahmonah a cang. Ma taco cawngsaw heh a pungpaluh tah papia palui ka, a hringnah khah a zongmingtei tah me tah ro ka, ama cawh hraihming me takhei me a rosah.
Saraang phing vytei cang seh, pavaw sahlo le, a lai thaipaw saraang sahlo le tuisaw sahlo cang seh, hreh teipaw cang he ka, cawngsaw tah aa hreh tei he,
canghrasala lui cawh ahotahmai hreh khy bei he. Ama cawh a ca-ing thai lypaw chahlynah thihnah sichia tah a chihpaw a cang.
Kaa lui hei kaa Buipaw le kaa Paw cawh reithai he peh ka, kaa lui hei Khazing hmuisang kai tei tuapaw cawngsaw khah chia kaa sah he.
Kaw kawkheh taihei reithainah le chiasahnah cawh aa ka pia. Ka uny sahlo, ma hrahei a cang ruapaw cang be.
Tuihnaw hnawkheh taitah a thlungpaw le a aepaw tui a piahrui khy he maw?
Ka uny sahlo thuiku kung taitah oliv thui a thui thai maw? A cang ly leh misur zung taitah thuiku a thui thai maw? Aa thui thai lypaw hratah a aepaw tuihnaw taitah a thlungpaw tui chuh khy hrá be.
Singnah phinghning

Naa hrong letah a singpaw le hming a hnih thaipaw cawh ahomaw a cang? A singnah le a hnithainah cawh singnah taitei a va chuhpaw a panyná tei a tuapaw a tuasanah achawpaw le a hringzia achawpaw khei a langsah seh.

Canghrasala naa lungthing cawh thingaenah le hnachuanah le ma zawng rawhnah longtei tah a chi caco, singnah a hnuipaw ka cang peh tatah a palai a patui khe la, biahmuisui dynah takhei hingbia khah rei khe o.
Ma, “Singnah,” cawh vaicung lang tah a vongpaw cang lytah alui leteipaw, Thlawpaw a pahlawh lypaw, Setan singnah tukhah a cang hri.
Zecawtamaw tatah hnachuanah le ma zawng longtei a rawhnah hminghmaw leco, hnahnawhnah le achaw lypaw tuasanah maikaw khah a chuh tei.
Canghrasala vaicung lang tei a vongpaw singnah cawh a hmetawcai tah a pathai; Mataico denah a du, zawngrawhnah a hnui, rei a nge, zangsawná tah chih ka, thuichaw a thui, hmeming zawng be, ziatai be.
Denah thleci a tupaw sahlo taco dingnah thuipa khah aa chuasah.
